why_it_moved.text: The overall rate is flat because gains and losses cancel by query class: Successful Search Rate is +3.40% on Tail Queries, -0.53% on Head Queries and -1.07% on Navigational.
why_it_moved.label: measured

why_it_moved.text: The new ranker probably surfaces better results for rare, long-tail queries and slightly displaces the right top result on navigational ones; Reformulation Rate on Navigational rose 1.71%.
why_it_moved.label: inferred

why_it_moved.text: CTR - Mobile fell 1.43% while Successful Search Rate - Mobile did not clearly move; no cut has been run on it.
why_it_moved.label: guess

would_change: A Tail Queries cut on triggered queries showing the lift holds and the other classes do not fall would justify a rerun aimed at tail traffic.
A sample split or logging imbalance within Tail Queries by arm would mean the tail lift is an artifact.
A pre-exposure comparison of Successful Search Rate showing a gap between arms would undermine this read.
